items.title: AWS emulator
items.title_zh: AWS 用自主 AI 智能体打造了一个 AWS 模拟器
items.title_en: AWS Built an AWS Emulator Using Autonomous AI Agents
items.summary: AWS describes an emulator built by autonomous AI agents, sparking HN debate about agent-written code, product viability, security boundaries, and existing cloud emulation alternatives.

items.title: Tim Peters has died
items.title_zh: 《Python 之禅》与 timsort 作者 Tim Peters 逝世，享年 73 岁
items.title_en: Tim Peters, author of the Zen of Python and timsort, dies at 73
items.summary: The Python community mourns the passing of Tim Peters (1952-2026), legendary CPython contributor and author of the Zen of Python and timsort.

items.title: Using voltage glitching to unleash the A100 in my mining card
items.title_zh: 电压毛刺攻击解锁 NVIDIA 矿卡中的 A100 级 80GB HBM 显存
items.title_en: Voltage Glitching Unlocks A100-Class 80GB HBM in an NVIDIA Mining Card
items.summary: A hardware hacker uses voltage glitching to blow/bypass fuses and unlock A100-class 80GB HBM functionality in a consumer mining card, sparking detailed discussion on GPU binning and DIY unlock methods.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO roadshow video
items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 路演视频披露四类芯片并行训练与推理策略
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO roadshow reveals four-chip training and serving strategy
items.summary: Anthropic's IPO roadshow video reveals new details about its business and its unconventional multi-chip strategy for training and serving Claude across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs, with Simon Willison providing an extracted transcript.

items.title: Stripe 宣布 OpenRouter 并入旗下
items.title_zh: Stripe 宣布将 OpenRouter 并入旗下，布局 AI 经济基础设施
items.title_en: Stripe Absorbs OpenRouter to Build AI Economic Infrastructure
items.summary: Stripe announced that OpenRouter has been folded into the company, framing the move as building economic infrastructure for AI with capabilities for exploring new models and optimizing token routing and usage.
